brief:
Israeli occupation forces launched coordinated military operations throughout the occupied West Bank on Thursday at dawn, IMEMC News reported. Troops invaded multiple cities, towns, and refugee camps across the territory, conducting home invasions and conducting violent searches of Palestinian residences. The raids resulted in the abduction of several Palestinians during the operation.

The military sweeps were accompanied by a significant deployment of additional Israeli forces across the West Bank. The timing and scale of the operations underscored the ongoing nature of Israeli military activity in Palestinian-controlled areas of the occupied territory.
